purpose: New channel-disjoint development and locked validation cohort; selection before caption availability or model inference
selection: Three newest public RSS entries per channel, ordered by publishedAt descending then videoId. Exclude original benchmark/smoke/canary IDs and all original channels. No replacement based on transcript availability, label count or model result. Exclusions and feed failures retained. All durations eligible.
split: SHA256 ordered channel IDs: first three tune, remaining three test. Exact allocation fixed here.
labels: Snapshot public SponsorBlock sponsor/selfpromo after selecting IDs; absence remains unknown; overlapping paid/selfpromo disputed before inference
candidates: fixed registered overlap study operating points
selectionPolicy: Reuse existing fixed conservative selection/promotion rules on development tune only; no expanding candidate grids
validation: Freeze model/code/config/fixtures before first test prediction; separate exposure ledger, never modify original exposed ledger. Compare configurations declared before exposure; report unknown and unavailable separately. Human reference review and campaign checks remain required.
trainingOverlap: Unknown. Recent uploads and channel disjointness from our benchmark do not establish absence from upstream model training. Do not infer training cutoff from repository modification time.
inference: Chrome only; acquisition runs with extension detection disabled. No subagents/API credits.
